principle: SAME WORLD IS NOT THE SAME ROOM
within_family_reuse: ENCOURAGED for a parent, its related children, and related states in the same spatial group
cross_family_reuse_also_requires: THE FAMILIES STAY VISUALLY DISTINGUISHABLE WITH THE UI REMOVED
distinctness_test: If all UI were removed, the founder could still tell which family the plate belongs to.
future_families: F05 and later may not reuse another family's plate unless CROSS_FAMILY_REUSE_JUSTIFICATION is recorded on the environment manifest and passed as crossFamilyReuseJustification.
dispatch_gate: ENVIRONMENT_PLATE jobs that set sourcePlateFamilyId to a different family block as CROSS_FAMILY_PLATE_REUSE_UNJUSTIFIED when the justification is missing. Credits spent stay 0.
world_reference_is_not_plate_reuse: Image-to-image from a world reference may still be required by the reference-binding rule. That does not authorize copying the previous family's room.
